config.key.name: Open/close gallery keybinds
config.key.tooltip: Defaults to keyboard G only. Configure multiple keys or button combinations, including your own controller combo; any binding toggles the gallery.
config.speed-key.name: Replay speed keybinds
config.speed-key.tooltip: Cycles 1x/2x/4x during replay without moving the cursor. Defaults to the controller right shoulder button; multiple keys or combinations are supported.
config.warning.name: Show rollback warning
config.warning.tooltip: Before the first replay after loading a save, warn that failed recovery returns to the latest overnight save. Backups remain mandatory when disabled.
config.auto-dialogue.name: Auto-advance normal dialogue
config.auto-dialogue.tooltip: Only applies at 2x/4x. Normal dialogue advances after its text finishes; choices always wait for the player.
config.debug.name: Debug diagnostics (detailed logs and JSON)
config.debug.tooltip: Off by default. Enable, reopen the gallery or reproduce the replay; detailed scan and replay logs are hidden while disabled. JSON folder: {{path}}
